description: Thirty texts from the committed sweep lists, each for Harry, Frank, Dennis, Kit, Ursula, Rita and Wendy at 180 words per minute. Chosen by rule before any export: the tenth entry of each of the fourteen groups of dectalk-us-sweep-v1; every seventh entry of dectalk-us-sweep-b-v1 from the third; every seventh entry of dectalk-us-paragraph-sweep-v1 from the fourth. A text that is not sample-exact for Paul would have been replaced by the next entry of its group; none of the thirty needed it. Each entry's group names its source entry.
